name: customergpt
description: AI-generated sales-objection roleplay, at scale. React + serverless rebuild.
comment-on-deps: @upstash/ratelimit and @upstash/redis are BUILD-time requirements even though they are only used at runtime when UPSTASH_* env vars are set: guard.ts reaches them via dynamic import, and a bundler must resolve every reachable import to build the serverless functions — omitting them fails the Vercel build with 'Could not resolve'. @vercel/node is type-only (erased at build) but keeps `tsc -p api` honest.
